hook_stat.sub: Earthen lamps lit across 56 ghats along the Saryu in Ayodhya for the 10th Deepotsav

stats.label: Ghats along the Saryu where lamps were lit
Volunteers who laid out and lit the lamps
Drones that recreated scenes from the Ramayana over the riverfront

diaspora_bullets: The 10th Deepotsav was held on Saturday, November 7, on the eve of Diwali
Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan was chief guest, alongside Governor Anandiben Patel and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath
news_summary: More than 30 lakh earthen lamps were lit across 56 ghats along the Saryu in Ayodhya on Saturday, November 7, for the 10th Deepotsav.
payoff: The official Guinness tally is still awaited against the 2025 record of 26.17 lakh lamps.
